2608.04548.title: A Model Merging Approach for Continual MLLM Unlearning
2608.04548.paper_summary: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) unlearning methods have been proposed to remove private, sensitive, or proprietary information from well-trained models. However, most existing MLLM unlearning methods are designed for one-shot requests and fail to adequately address continual scenarios, as repeatedly applying one-shot operations leads to cumulative utility degradation, unlearning rebound, and retention drift. We introduce Merging for Continual Unlearning (MCU), an approach that dynamically merges multiple one-shot unlearning adapters into a unified adapter upon receiving each new unlearning request.Through a leave-one-out merging analysis, we reveal that these unlearning adapters exhibit strong cross-task dependencies. Such dependencies have two contrasting effects: they can facilitate cross-task unlearning transferability, but they can also introduce severe interference that degrades unlearning effectiveness and compromises retained knowledge. To address this challenge, MCU projects the adapters into a shared representation space, preserves their dominant directions, suppresses over-concentrated coordinates, and reconfigures cross-task dependencies to mitigate interference while enhancing transferability. Experiments on ICU-Bench and MLLMU-Bench demonstrate that MCU achieves superior unlearning effectiveness while preserving both retained knowledge and general multimodal utility.
2608.04548.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）去學習方法已被提出，以從訓練良好的模型中移除私密、敏感或專有信息。然而，大多數現有的MLLM去學習方法是為一次性請求而設計的，未能充分解決持續場景，因為重複應用一次性操作會導致累積效用下降、去學習反彈和保留漂移。我們介紹了持續去學習的合併方法（MCU），這是一種在接收到每個新的去學習請求時，動態地將多個一次性去學習適配器合併為統一適配器的方法。通過留一法合併分析，我們揭示這些去學習適配器顯示出強烈的跨任務依賴性。這種依賴性有兩種對立的效果：它們可以促進跨任務去學習的可轉移性，但也可能引入嚴重的干擾，降低去學習的有效性並妨礙保留知識。為了解決這一挑戰，MCU將適配器投影到共享表示空間中，保留其主導方向，抑制過度集中坐標，並重新配置跨任務依賴性，以減輕干擾同時增強可轉移性。在ICU-Bench和MLLMU-Bench上的實驗表明，MCU在保持保留知識和一般多模態效用的同時，實現了卓越的去學習有效性。
